<entry id="M02624">
<head-word>מַרְזֵחַ</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown"> זחח or זוח</xref>,
<xref rid="A00083"> with ר inserted)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>merry-making, banquet</italic>, also 
<italic>the banquet given to mourners to cheer them up</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 5, v. מַרְזוֹחַ.—[M. Kat. 28
<sup>b</sup>, v. מַר II.]—
<plural-form>Pl. מַרְזֵחִים, מַרְזֵחִין, מַרְזֵי'</plural-form>. Sifré Num. 131 חזרו לעשות להם מ' they (the Moabites) again arranged (idolatrous) banquets for them. Koh. R. to VII, 1, end הכל סופדין עושה לו מ' … all people lament and clap hands over the death of the righteous man (Samuel), and this wicked man (Nabal) holds banquets; Yalk. Sam. 134; Midr. Sam. ch. XXIII. Esth. R. to I, 2; ib. to I, 9; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02625">
<head-word>מַרְזֵחָא</head-word>
<head-word>מַרְזֵי'</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>1) same.</definition>
<notes> ch. </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same. Keth. 69
<sup>a</sup>, v. infra.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. מַרְזְחִין, מַרְזֵיחִין</plural-form>. Targ. Am. VI, 7. Targ. Y. I Num. XXV, 2 (v. Sifré Num. 131, quot. in preced.).—Esp. (
<italic>banquet</italic>) 
<italic>exhilarating the mourner;</italic> (בֵּית) בֵּי מ' 
<italic>the place of the mourners’ meal</italic>. Targ. Jer. XVI, 5.—Keth. 69
<sup>a</sup> מאן יתיב בי מ' וכ' who sits at the head at mourners’ meals? expl. ib.
<sup>b</sup> מהו מ' אֵבֶל (
<italic>be</italic>-)
<italic>marze</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>a</italic> means (house of) mourning (ref. to Jer. l. c.).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="M02622">מַרְזוֹחַ</xref>) 
<plural-form>pl. מַרְזְחַיָּיא</plural-form>
<italic>those who cheer the mourners</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. II Esth. I, 3 ed. Frf. (v. מְסַחֲרַיָּא).—Y. Ber. III, 6
<sup>a</sup> top (reprehending the excesses at mourners’ meals). לאתקבלון … למחר מ' (not מזרח') after my death do not receive today mourning (condolence) and to-morrow merry-makers.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M02630">
<head-word>מָרַח</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> sec. r. of רוח)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to soften; to poultice</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>מֵירֵחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to strike a plaster, rub a salve;</italic> in gen. 
<italic>to mash, crush</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Sabb. V (VI), 6 המְמָרֵחַ בשבת he who mashes ingredients for a plaster on the Sabbath; Erub. 102
<sup>b</sup>; Y. ib. X, 26
<sup>c</sup>.—Sabb. 75
<sup>b</sup> הממ' רטיה וכ' he who spreads and presses the poultice over a sore; Y. ib. VII, 10
<sup>d</sup> top. Ib. XXII, 3 (146
<sup>a</sup>) he must not put on wax מפני שהוא ממרח (Mish. Pes. מַמְרִיחַ, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90) because 
<pgbrk id="pg841" />it is an act resembling the spreading of plaster. Sifra Sh’mini, Par. 8, ch. X; Kel. V, 11 מֵרְחָהּ בטיט if he smeared clay over it; Tosef. ib. B. Kam. IV, 10; 12. Ib. VII, 10 ומי' שפתותיה עם הכותל and connected its rims with the wall by plaster or pitch; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְמוֹרָח 
<italic>crushed</italic>. Bekh. 44
<sup>b</sup> האי ממ' אשך וכ' (not ממרוח) if 
<italic>m’roa</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic> meant 
<italic>crushed</italic>, it ought to read 
<italic>m’mora</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic> &c.; Yalk. Lev. 632, v. מְרוֹחַ.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to pass</italic> (the hand) 
<italic>over a viscid mass, to wipe off, rub off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. VII, 10
<sup>a</sup> bot. מְמָרְחֹו בידו אחת he may wipe (or brush) it off with one hand; (Bab. ib. 141
<sup>a</sup> מגרר בצפרן).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to give a pile of grain an even shape, to finish the process of storing up.</italic></definition>
<notes> Maasr. I, 6 משיְמָרֵחַ ואם אינו מְמָרֵחַ וכ' (Y. ed. מְמָרֵיחַ or מַמְרִיחַ) (is subject to tithes) as soon as he evens the pile, and if he does not even &c.; expl. Y. ib. I, 49
<sup>a</sup> bot. מן דו ישפר וכ' when he gives a finish to the surface of the pile. Ib. בשאין בדעתו למָרֵחַ (not לימרח) when he has not the intention to even the pile; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְמוֹרָח, f. מְמוֹרַחַת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְמוֹרָחִין; מְמוֹרָחוֹת</plural-form>. Bekh. 11
<sup>a</sup>, sq. טבלים ממ' (Ar. מְרוּחִים) untithed grain stored up in proper shape. Y. Peah IV, 16
<sup>c</sup> bot. כרי ממ' a finished pile; a. e.—Tosef. Ter. IV, 15 מוּרַחַת = ממורחת.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (denom. of רַחַת) 
<italic>to winnow</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Part. pass. as ab. Tosef. Maasr. II, 17 מצא תבואה ממ' עשויה כרי וכ' if one finds winnowed grain (which has been abandoned), if it is made up into a pile, you dare not take it, opp. מפוזרת scattered; Y. ib. III, 50
<sup>c</sup> bot. פירות ממורחין.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִמְרַח</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be crushed into a viscid mass</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bekh. VII, 5 (expl. מרוח אשך, Lev. XXI, 20) כל שנִמְרְחוּ אשכיו (Bab. ed., 44
<sup>b</sup>, נימחו) whose testicles are crushed; (refuted ib. in Gem.) האי ממורח וכ', v. supra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be smeared over</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VII, 10 עד שתִּמָּרֵחַ עם השפה until it is smeared over so as to be even with the rim.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְמָרֵחַ, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְמָרֵחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be shaped into an even pile, to be finished</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Peah I, beg. 15
<sup>a</sup> עד שלא נתמ' הכר as long as the pile is not struck off; a. e. [Y. Maasr. I, 49
<sup>a</sup> bot. תבואה משיתמרח, read: משימרח, v. supra.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="M02635">

<entry id="M02642">
<head-word>מָרַט</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to pluck off</italic> (hair, wool &c.); 
<italic>to pull</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Sabb. IX (X), 20; Sabb. 74
<sup>b</sup> והמוֹרְטוֹ and he who plucks the down off the large feather of the wing. B. Mets. 68
<sup>b</sup> גוזזות ושוטפות ומֹורְטֹות (Ar. גזוזות) they yield wool by being shorn, by passing through water, and by being plucked (in passing bushes &c.; [prob. to be read גזוזות ושטופות ומְרוּטוֹת].</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>מֵירֵט</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same. Naz. 39 same.</definition>
<notes> Naz. 39
<sup>b</sup> תלש מ' סיפסף וכ' if he pinced his hair (near the root), plucked it off, or trimmed it &c.; (Ar. s. v. ספסף: ‘created a bald spot by using a depilatory’). Sabb. l. c. מְמָרֵט חייב משום ממחק he who plucks the down (v. supra) is guilty of an act coming under the head of scraping (leather).—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְמוֹרָט 
<italic>bald-headed</italic>. Naz. 46
<sup>b</sup>; Yoma 61
<sup>b</sup> נזיר ממ'; Tosef. Naz. I, 6 המוֹרָט; Y. ib. VI, end, 55
<sup>d</sup> נזיר ומירט (read: נזיר ממ' or מורט).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to smooth, polish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 12 נחשת ממורט (prob. to be read: מְמֹורֶטֶת) polished bronze.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִמְרַט</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be plucked, to be bald</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra Thazr., Par. 5, ch. X נ' ראשו וכ' if his head became bald through sickness.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="M02643">
<head-word>מְרַט</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>

<language-reference>same.</language-reference>

<sense>

<binyan>

<binyan-form>מָרֵיט</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>, v. infra.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Palp.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>מַרְטֵיט</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to pull to pieces, to divide, plunder</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Job XVI, 11 מְמַרְטֵט ed. Lag. (Ms. מרטיט, Var. מְמָרֵט 
<italic>Pa.;</italic> h. text ירטני). Targ. Ps. XXXIX, 3 כיבי ממרטיט he lacerates my wound (h. text נעכר).—Ḥull. 92
<sup>b</sup> ממרטט ליה he pulled the fatty fibres out (going to the root).
<pgbrk id="pg842" /></notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpalp.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיתְמַרְטֵט, אִימַּ'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be torn to pieces, dismembered</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. Zar. 69

<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>מֵירֵק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to polish up</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> (ref. to תמרוק, Prov. XX, 30) המְמָרֵק עצמו וכ' he who polishes himself (makes toilet, prepares himself) for a sinful act; (Rashi: who makes himself free from all other thoughts, devoting himself entirely to sin, v. infra).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. מכה בפטיש) 
<italic>to finish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Ḥull. I, 2 ומ' הגוי וכ' and a gentile finished the slaughtering (by cutting farther than the ritual requires); (Hull. 121
<sup>b</sup> גמר); Yoma III, 4 ומֵרַ'; Hull. 29
<sup>a</sup> ומֵי'. Tam. IV, 2 מ' את ההפשט he finishes the flaying. Mikv. X, 1 הכניסן … ולא מֵרְקָן he inserted the handles properly but did not finish them off (by fastening &c.). Ohol. <sup>c</sup>, a. e. מכיון שהתחיל … מָרֵק inasmuch as he commenced the act, we say to him, finish it; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cleanse</italic> from sin by suffering, 
<italic>to remove sin, effect forgiveness</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 5
<sup>a</sup> יסורין שמְמָרְקִין כל וכ' sufferings which cleanse the entire body of man; ib. ממרקין כל עונותיו וכ' wash away all sins of man; Yalk. Ex. 339; Yalk. Deut. 850. Yoma 86
<sup>a</sup> מיתה מְמָרֶקֶת death finishes the atonement (v. supra); Y. Snh. X, 27
<sup>c</sup> bot. מיתה ממרקת שליש death removes the last third of sins; a. fr.—Y. Keth. VI, beg. 30
<sup>c</sup> (in mixed dict.) ולא מְמָרֵק לה פורנה and does not pay off the entire dowry.—Sabb. 33
<sup>a</sup>, v. supra.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
